items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Our group consisted of Guy Lafitte, his wife, Widy, Caspoil, Suzette and his sister Dolores, Lily and myself.

ctx.x: One day, a few of us decided to go higher up in the mountains for a picnic in the snow. It was warmer up there where people went to ski than it was down in St. Moritz, and some folks were even taking sun bath. The hotel gave their clients box lunches for picnics and we took a funicular up to a station wherethe skiers disembark. If they care to go higher, there are ski-lifts to carry them to the highest points. There was also a hotel restaurant and chalets near the station.

Our group consisted of Guy Lafitte, his wife, Widy, Caspoil, Suzette and his sister Dolores, Lily and myself. We decided to walk higher up than where the station was situated, to eat our lunch. It was tough in some place as the snow was very deep and after climbing for an hour, we decided to stop and eat. We had bought some soft drinks at the station and really enjoyed the outing.

After a few hours, Dolores, Lily and I were ready to go back, and left the others. There was no fix pathway to come down, so we took what we thought was the right direction, as we could not see the station from where we were. And we ran in quite a bit of trouble. Sometimes we would sink down in the snow knee deep and once Dolores went down to her waist, and if she had been a person that weighed 150 pounds or more, we would have had to scream for help.
